name: slider
title: Slider
description: Drag a thumb to pick a number, or two thumbs for a range.

.tx-slider-thumb.background:
radial-gradient(circle at 38% 38%, var(--tx-rivet-dark) 0 1.5px, transparent 1.9px),
      radial-gradient(circle at 62% 38%, var(--tx-rivet-dark) 0 1.5px, transparent 1.9px),
      radial-gradient(circle at 38% 62%, var(--tx-rivet-dark) 0 1.5px, transparent 1.9px),
      radial-gradient(circle at 62% 62%, var(--tx-rivet-dark) 0 1.5px, transparent 1.9px),
      radial-gradient(circle, var(--tx-rivet-light) 55%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--tx-rivet-light) 70%, var(--tx-rivet)) 100%)
